title: Bombay High Court orders takedown of fake posts targeting Nitin Gadkari over E20 row
summary: The Bombay High Court ordered the removal of 'vile, abusive' online posts targeting Nitin Gadkari, a former Union Minister, over a funding dispute related to the E20 project. The court's order was issued in response to complaints filed by Gadkari and his supporters. The posts were deemed objectionable content by the court, which ordered their removal. The controversy revolves around a funding row between Gadkari and Google, with the former alleging that he was unfairly targeted by the search engine giant.
summary_points: The Bombay High Court issued an order to remove 'vile, abusive' online posts targeting Nitin Gadkari over a funding dispute related to the E20 project.
